criteria.rationale: The patient was 35 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
The request is for chronic weight management, and the recent visit documents interest in Wegovy for weight.
Diet and activity were planned in December 2025, outside the 180-day window. The August 2026 note does not document a current or continuing diet and activity plan.
The December note says the patient was enrolling in a program, but neither note establishes participation with continuing follow-up over a continuous six-month period.
The latest structured BMI before the request was 34.8 kg/m², above the 30 kg/m² threshold.

missing_requirements: Documentation within 180 days before the request that the patient is following or will continue both a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity alongside Wegovy.
Documentation of at least six continuous months of participation in a comprehensive weight management program with diet, activity, and continuing follow-up.
parsed.summary: Age, indication, and BMI meet policy requirements. The record does not establish a current diet-and-activity plan or six continuous months of program participation, so the request is not ready.
